technique_name: Summarize the key ideas of this article
description: This article explores consumer behavior from a psychological perspective, focusing on how unconscious and conscious motives factor into consumer decision-making. It also outlines how marketers can use consumer behavior knowledge to their advantage.
example: This article discusses the psychology of consumer behavior in marketing research. It explains how consumers make decisions on the basis of their unconscious and conscious motives and how a business can use consumer behavior to their advantage.
